budget_policy: Native task agent timeout minus 180 seconds, separate 1800-second setup. Native verifier per-attempt time limits; max three attempts, retry only timeouts against the same agent output.
execution_policy: All 34 model trials are fresh. Fixed ascending work-budget order, then task name; consecutive pairs finish before the next pair. No whole-trial retries, task replacements, or reuse of previous model outputs.
failure_policy: Keep all setup failures and verifier errors separate from scored failures. Retain native zeros even when assertions never start, but classify them as verifier errors in analysis.
preflight_policy: Fresh installation-only preflight for all 34 tasks before model work. QEMU has a reviewed verifier dependency profile; the other 33 are explicitly not_configured. A pre-model infrastructure amendment may reuse successful native installation trials only with complete hash-bound provenance and retain all failures.
information_policy: Use frozen current main without prompt or runtime tuning. Do not inspect new trajectories or hidden test contents until all new model outputs freeze. Prior development exposure is disclosed, and each completed trajectory will be audited for benchmark-answer exposure.
scope: One common-main baseline of the existing 34-task development pool, not a comparison with prior mixed-version results and not a random or held-out benchmark.

protocol_amendment.reason: Repair repeated installation download failures before any model work using a verified original-index transport cache.
protocol_amendment.transport_scope: Read-only APT configuration mount for named public HTTP origins only. No general HTTP/HTTPS proxy variables, changed sources, or rebuilt task images. API traffic and non-APT tools use their normal network path.
